query:
SELECT user_id AS "user_id!", count(*) AS "views!",
               percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lcp_ms) AS "lcp_p75"
        FROM rum_events
        WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
          AND ($1::text IS NULL OR app = $1)
          AND received_at > now() - make_interval(hours => $2)
        GROUP BY user_id
        ORDER BY count(*) DESC
        LIMIT 50
